text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races
alongside T.M. Opera O—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Trainer-kun, it seems the time has finally come.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The sealed Pandora's box is thrown open! Now is the time to release the hope resting at its very bottom upon the world!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, bring forth that box!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how lamentable... Have you
forgotten? About that prize.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it was just after the New Year.
I was taking a stroll through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs trip sounds wonderful.
I'd love to go right away, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Until the proper time comes, please seal it with
the king's crest in wax and keep it safe.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Something like that happened, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Yes, the time is finally ripe. With the Series wrapping up, it's the perfect time for a restorative break."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The "End-of-Century Overlord" requires an end-of-century resort!Let us depart! To the end-of-century hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no hot spring by that name, but
we decided to set off for a hot spring anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a nice bath. Even so...
Ah, how vexing...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the beautifying waters has made my already exquisite skin radiate like a precious jewel, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is a white night. Even if the sun sets,
my beauty will illuminate this land.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Furthermore, my beauty will serve as a new source,
causing a lavish torrent of premium hot spring water to gush forth!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Of course I'll go!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Even when I became the 'Overlord of the End of the Century,'
you truly never wavered, did you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once T.M. Opera O's grand speech
came to a pause, we returned to the room
and enjoyed some delicious food.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was truly delicious... Western culture
may be my specialty, but Japanese style is wonderful from time to time too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
By the way, my dear Trainer.
There is something I would like to ask you while we have the chance...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Are you, um... really evaluating me
accurately?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Simply put, it's like this.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am strong! I am fast! I am arrogant
and invincible! That is universally acknowledged by all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Plus, every now and then, you tell me things like "You're strong!" or "As expected!"
I like that about you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: On top of that, I'm simply magnificent! As I've said so many times before.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet you rarely tell me
that I'm "beautiful," do you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It might just be my imagination, but...
I feel like there isn't enough praise and appreciation for beauty around here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They won't compliment her beauty.
That seems to be what's bothering her.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So, allow me to ask now. If you do not find it
beautiful, that is quite alright.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: No matter what you think, the truth that I am beautiful will never change.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even so! Despite all that! By all means!
I want to know for sure.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do you...
think that I am beautiful?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How should I handle this...?
Calm down and think carefully.
And then...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Really? Do you truly, genuinely think so?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No...! 
No! No no no!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Did you really have to put it that way?
Maybe say it a bit more, you know...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Call it exaggerated or dramatic, but that kind of
embellishment is only natural, right!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Please... don't say things like that with a straight face.
I won't know how to respond...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: How should I put it... The sheer destructive power is...
choice_data_list: I was just saying what I really think, though?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Stop... Please stop.
That... innocent onslaught of yours...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite used to speaking from the heart.
Perhaps in more clownish words...
choice_data_list: You're truly magnificent, T.M. Opera O.
You're truly magnificent, T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Uwooooooogh, I'm melting... This is bad...
What is this place called an "onsen"...?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My presence as the "End-of-Century Overlord" is... melting away...I surrender. A white flag... wave the white flaaag!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O waving the white flag.
The battle had ended, revealing an unexpected weakness.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...
If that's how it's gonna be... I'll conquer it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
During this trip, I must learn to withstand
your innocent words.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A temporary tactical retreat to the thermae!
Once my fighting spirit is restored, I shall return!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Remember this~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A siege battle at the hot spring resort. Afterward, T.M. Opera O
is showered with praise and ended up defeated at her own game."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond
with T.M. Opera O...
